sentence_stem: Rarely have I seen such dedication,
correct_completion: as this team has shown this year.
full_sentence: Rarely have I seen such dedication as this team has shown this year.
acceptable_variants: as this team has demonstrated this year.
as this group has displayed recently.

options.text: so the team has shown this year.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but the inverted 'rarely' structure requires a comparison completed by 'as'.

options.text: as this team has shown this year.

options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause and does not complete the comparison that 'such ... as' requires.

options.text: but this team works harder every day.
options.why_wrong: 'But' signals contrast, while the stem sets up a comparison of dedication, not a contrast.

grammar_focus: Negative inversion after 'rarely' with a 'such ... as' comparison
explanation: After a fronted 'rarely', the auxiliary verb comes before the subject. The sentence then completes the comparison with 'such ... as', which is a common pattern in formal and literary writing.
translation: Rzadko widziałem tak wielkie oddanie, jakie ten zespół okazał w tym roku.
